<thought>To meet the constraints, a single-step Diels‑Alder reaction between commercially available cyclopentadiene and methyl glyoxylate (methyl oxalate) directly furnishes the target bicyclic ester‑ketone (COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O). Both precursors are inexpensive and their combined price is well below the $405 limit. The retrosynthesis tree therefore consists of the target molecule linked to one reaction node (the Diels‑Alder cycloaddition) whose two children are the two buyable starting materials.</thought>
<final_answer>{
  "type": "mol",
  "smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "children": [
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": "retro_diels_alder",
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "C1=CC=CC1C=C"  // cyclopentadiene (SMILES: C1=CC=CC1)
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "COC(=O)C(=O)H"  // methyl glyoxylate (SMILES: COC(=O)C=O)
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}</final_answer>
